research_topic: How many dimensions are there in space?
reframed_question: Which extra-dimension model classes are observationally distinguishable across complementary channels, and what would exclude them within declared assumptions?
non_negotiable_invariants: Distinguish observed extended dimensions from formal-theory dimensions and compactified dimensions.
Bind every constraint to an explicit model and parameterization.
Do not state that extra dimensions have been discovered or globally disproved.
Preserve model-translation uncertainty and competing non-extra-dimensional explanations.
Maintain DESIGN_ONLY and report no new measurements.
recommended_direction: Build a cross-scale model-to-observable falsifiability atlas with an explicit observational-identifiability status.
